facts.label: Passado: transporte
facts.sub: Use took, missed, left e arrived para contar o problema. Pergunte When is the next train? Do I need a new ticket? e responda com ten minutes ago.

facts.label: Na estação
facts.sub: Na estação, procure o balcão de informações ou os painéis. Diga Excuse me, I took the wrong train. Os funcionários costumam ser gentis e dão a próxima opção rapidamente.

facts.label: Horários

pages.title: A big train station · 1/3
paragraphs: It is nine thirty in a big train station in Boston. People run, talk and look at the board. Ben stands near the information desk. His shirt is wet and his hair is messy. A kind agent named Ida looks up from her screen. She sees he needs help.
“Hello. Can I help you?” says Ida. “Yes, please. I took the wrong train this morning.” says Ben. “Oh no. Where did you want to go?” says Ida.
